newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG BEATEN AGAIN AT LYON IN FRENCH LEAGUE CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG BEATEN AGAIN AT LYON IN FRENCH LEAGUE CUP.

text.p: European Cup Winners' Cup holders Paris Saint-Germain lost for the second time in succession when they crashed out of the French League Cup 2-1 in Lyon on Tuesday.
European Cup quarter-finalists Auxerre were also eliminated in the second round. They went down 3-2 at Marseille, their opponents again in the league on Sunday.
Monaco, who replaced PSG at the top of the league at the weekend after PSG's shock 2-1 home loss to Nancy, meet second division Troyes at home on Wednesday.
Midfielder Laurent Fournier put PSG in front after only three minutes in a counter-attack, but within two minutes Lyon were level.
Striker Franck Gava hit home the rebound after France goalkeeper Bernard Lama let a shot from Alain Caveglia bounce back off his chest.
Caveglia had a header blocked on the line in the second half as Lyon pushed PSG into their own half and minutes later he had to be substituted for concussion after a collision with Lama.
Substitute Frederic Patouillard hit the winner 15 minutes from time when PSG's defence failed to clear a corner.
Marseille fell behind after two astonishing misses, midfielder Ludovic Assuar blasting the ball over in front of an empty goal, then Reynald Pedros hit the bar.

Striker Steve Marlet, who scored two crucial European champions' league goals for Auxerre, put the visitors ahead against the run of play when he profited from a mistake by defender Hamada Jambay in the 22nd minute.

Striker Marc Libbra equalised six minutes later and Pedros put Marseille ahead four minutes after the interval when he headed past Auxerre keeper Fabien Cool from a deft lob by Bulgarian Yordan Lechkov over three defenders.
It was Pedros's first goal for Marseille since joining them from Nantes in the off-season.
Jambay made up for his error on Marlet's opening goal by driving home Marseille's crucial third in the 59th minute.
Marlet pulled one back for the champions with 22 minutes to go.
